text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A $15 million granite factory in Bahrain is to start production within days, official says.
- Gulf Arab states' chambers of commerce to jointly finance Bahrain-based arbitration centre, official says.
- Russian official invites Bahraini businessmen to visit Russia to help boost commercial ties.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Co (Batelco) is expected to post between four to five percent rise in net profit for 1996.
